about: Build queue. Work the 'ready' items top to bottom without re-asking the owner; they are decided. 'blocked' items wait on what 'blocked_on' says. When an item is done, delete it here and add a 'done' entry to progress.json (replacing its 'planned' entry if it has one).

items.title: Mortal units, fallen heroes
items.decided: Owner, 2026-10-07: units are mortal; heroes fall and can be revived.
spec: Basic troops and workers (every role except CAPTAIN, CHAMPION, BEAST) die for good, as now.

Player-owned Captains, Champions and war beasts don't die: at lethal damage they fall instead (cancel the death, health to 1, a FALLEN state synced to the client so they lie down; raiders' heroes still die).
While fallen: no AI or attacks, untargetable by enemies, can't be hurt; the owner sees a chat line saying where it fell. Window: 60 seconds (config).
Owner right-clicks a fallen hero within the window: it gets up at 50% health, with a short sound and particle cue.

Window runs out: the hero leaves the world and goes on its owner's 'returning heroes' list (a player attachment: role, race, tier, ready time). After 5 minutes (config) the owner can re-summon it at any of their altars for 50% of its mana cost; the altar menu shows returning heroes with a countdown.
Returning heroes still count toward beastLimit and the army cap, so they can't be dodged by letting heroes fall.

Game tests: a Champion at lethal damage falls instead of dying; a fallen hero is revived by its owner at half health; an expired hero lands on the returning list and is summoned at half cost; a Footman still dies.

Render layer on players wearing the Mana Glider: folded flat on the back on the ground, spread wide while gliding, with a blend between the two.
Render previews (folded, gliding, from behind and the side), compare against the item icon, add the render to the Codex progress entry.

items.title: Siege outposts and the raid chest
spec: Some siege waves build a temporary enemy outpost nearby; the siege can't be won while it stands.
At its heart, a large raid chest with custom art (from the owner's reference). Loot it, break it, and the whole outpost despawns.

Proposed defaults if the owner accepts them: outposts on boss waves (every 5th) plus a small chance from wave 8; a camp (tents, palisade, watchtower) below wave 10, a small fort from wave 10; the outpost sends a few raiders every couple of minutes until taken.
